audio.text: Do you mind if I open the window a bit?

options: Go ahead, it's getting stuffy in here.
Yes, I'll mind your bag while you're gone.
The window looks out on the main square.
I opened a bank account last week.

why.en: Permission request → "Go ahead" grants it. B uses "mind" in another sense (= look after), and "Yes" here would actually mean a refusal; D repeats "open" with another meaning.
why.tr: İzin isteme → "Go ahead" izin veriyor. B "mind" kelimesini başka anlamda (= göz kulak olmak) kullanıyor, üstelik burada "Yes" aslında itiraz anlamına gelir; D "open" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor.
why.es: Petición de permiso → "Go ahead" lo concede. B usa "mind" en otro sentido (= vigilar), y aquí "Yes" significaría en realidad que sí le molesta; D repite "open" con otro significado.
